crossRefs.note: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like…
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’ ” “Yes,” says the…
“ ‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat…
But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you…
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you…
“ ‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell…
In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the…
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness…

translations.web: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
translations.bsb: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
translations.kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
translations.asv: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety. Psalm 5 For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.
